requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder implementation has fundamental flaws in its async handling. It incorrectly processes StopIteration exceptions and doesn't properly handle the flow control for async generators. Many tests fail because the builder returns None instead of proper Option values.
requirement.contract: Fix the async_option builder to correctly process async generators and return proper Option values (Some or Nothing) based on the generator's execution flow. The builder must handle StopIteration properly to return the final value wrapped in Some, or return Nothing when StopIteration occurs without a value.
requirement.acceptance: test_async_option_builder_evaluation_order, test_async_option_builder_short_circuit, test_async_option_builder_combine, test_async_option_builder_return_from, test_async_option_builder_yield_some, test_async_option_builder_yield_nothing, test_async_option_builder_multiple_operations, test_async_option_builder_nested, test_async_option_builder_throws, test_async_option_builder_return_some, test_async_option_builder_yield_some_wrapped, test_async_option_builder_yield_value_async, test_async_option_builder_while, test_async_option_builder_projection_int_str, test_async_option_builder_with_async_functions, test_async_option_builder_with_async_option_functions, test_async_option_builder_with_nested_async_generators

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder implementation has the same fundamental flaws as AsyncOptionBuilder. It doesn't properly handle async generator execution and returns None instead of proper Result values (Ok or Error). Several tests fail due to incorrect handling of StopIteration and lack of proper error propagation.
requirement.contract: Fix the async_result builder to correctly process async generators and return proper Result values (Ok or Error) based on the generator's execution flow. The builder must handle StopIteration properly to return the final value wrapped in Ok, or return Error when StopIteration occurs without a value or when exceptions are raised.
requirement.acceptance: test_async_result_builder_evaluation_order, test_async_result_builder_short_circuit, test_async_result_builder_combine, test_async_result_builder_return_from, test_async_result_builder_zero, test_async_result_builder_yield_ok, test_async_result_builder_yield_error, test_async_result_builder_multiple_operations, test_async_result_builder_nested, test_async_result_builder_throws, test_async_result_builder_return_ok, test_async_result_builder_yield_ok_wrapped, test_async_result_builder_return_error_wrapped, test_async_result_builder_yield_value_async, test_async_result_builder_while, test_async_result_builder_projection_int_str, test_async_result_builder_yield_error_short_circuit, test_async_result_builder_with_async_functions, test_async_result_builder_with_async_result_functions, test_async_result_builder_with_nested_async_generators

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder implementation has issues with handling generators properly. Tests like test_seq_builder_yield_sequence_wrapped and test_seq_builder_throws are failing, indicating that the builder doesn't correctly handle sequence yields and exception propagation.
requirement.contract: Fix the seq builder to properly handle generator execution, including proper handling of yield statements, exception propagation, and return values. The builder should correctly process sequences and handle both regular yields and yield from statements.

requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder's _send method doesn't correctly handle EffectError exceptions that should trigger short-circuiting behavior. When Nothing is yielded, it should immediately short-circuit instead of continuing execution.
requirement.contract: Update the _send method in AsyncOptionBuilder to properly detect EffectError (Nothing) and short-circuit execution immediately, setting the done flag and returning the appropriate Nothing value.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder's _send method doesn't correctly handle EffectError exceptions that should trigger short-circuiting behavior. When Error is yielded, it should immediately short-circuit instead of continuing execution.
requirement.contract: Update the _send method in AsyncResultBuilder to properly detect EffectError (Error) and short-circuit execution immediately, setting the done flag and returning the appropriate Error value.
